plugins.name: pacing
plugins.description: This skill spends your weekly plan allowance on purpose. It keeps a ladder of models. The top tier is your session model and does the work that needs judgment; the lower tiers do easier work through subagents. A day-by-day budget and the logged trend decide how far down the ladder work goes, so the week never runs out before the reset.
